title: Arkret Durable Device Revocation State
description: Reducer-owned durable state for an accepted ak.device.revoke Control Move. A revoke is never an Ack-less self-principal PCR Move: accepted Event, canonical ControlProposalAck and this record are committed atomically. The record binds the exact principal authority, device authorization and generation observed at admission; producers cannot author those derived selectors. revocation_pending blocks the five registered action classes on every deployment until the exact proposal is either covered by an accepted Seal or terminated by a valid signed_reject under the same Ack authority contract.

device_revocation_gate_record.description: Gate-relevant durable state for an exact device generation. Rejected records are audit history and are excluded; pending and revoked records remain visible together so sealing one proposal cannot hide another surviving pending proposal.

device_generation_ref.description: Reducer-derived PCR-local monotonic current device-generation selector. A producer MUST NOT self-report it and it MUST NOT equal or be derived from a DID versionId.

denied_actions.description: Closed canonical action-class list blocked by revocation_pending on every deployment.

target_device_authorize_event_id.description: Reducer-derived accepted ak.device.authorize Event targeted by this proposal.

accepted_at.description: Actual durable atomic-commit time assigned when the Event, canonical Ack, derived selectors and pending index commit. It is independent of, and MUST NOT be copied from, a pre-collected ControlProposalAck.received_at.

acceptance_seq.description: Monotonic sequence assigned by the origin Principal Server in the same atomic commit as accepted_at and the pending index.

control_proposal_ack.description: Mandatory canonical Ack committed with the accepted revoke. ak.device.revoke is excluded from the authority-authored Ack-less exception. Ack.received_at records Ack issuance and is not the pending record's accepted_at.

terminal_decision.description: The only transition that clears this proposal's pending gate. Its proposal_digest and proposal_ack_digest MUST match this record, and its verified authority set MUST be the Ack authority set.

device_revocation_gate_check_request_bod.description: Authenticated S2S request from an Account Authority or another registered issuer to the exact origin Principal Server. The exact authorization Event and PCR-local generation are derived from the origin's locked durable current device projection. expected selectors are issuer-verified, appear together or not at all, and MAY be omitted only for session_grant_issue or returning_session_grant_issue. returning_session_grant_issue and human session_grant_refresh require AcceptedDevicePossessionProof; registration/recovery session_grant_issue uses its already verified durable root/recovery evidence and forbids that proof. The intent digest identifies immutable prepared issuance or refresh bytes.

intent_digest.description: Digest of the complete immutable issue or refresh intent, including the exact grant id, jti, subject, device, audience, scope, holder binding, issued_at and expiry. Session-grant introspection is read-only issuer-ledger verification and never consumes this receipt.

accepted_device_possession_proof.description: Required only for returning_session_grant_issue and human session_grant_refresh. The origin verifies it with the accepted device key from the same locked durable projection used to decide current authorization. Registration/recovery session_grant_issue and Agent runtime issuers MUST omit it.

device_revocation_gate_decision_receipt.description: Origin-Principal-Server-signed durable linearization receipt. Under the same database lock/serializable transaction used to accept ak.device.revoke, the origin derives the current authorization Event and generation from its own durable projection, compares them with any expected binding in the request, and atomically records (action_class,intent_digest) at linearization_seq before signing. Derivation is a partial function: a device with no current accepted authorization has no derived selector and returns authority_mismatch; authorization_absent is deliberately not a separate decision. Only an allow carries the derived target_device_authorize_event_id and target_device_generation_ref, and that pair is the sole source for the issued grant's device_binding; the issuer MUST copy it verbatim and MUST NOT accept a binding from client input. No other decision discloses the derived binding, so a generation_mismatch cannot be turned into a silent re-issue at the new generation. Exact replay returns byte-identical output. An allow records that exact immutable issue/refresh intent as lawfully admitted before any later revocation_pending transition; a later pending transition blocks only intents linearized after it. The issuer MUST atomically commit the same immutable intent plus this receipt before expires_at and MUST NOT mint a new/different intent after pending. The receipt authorizes no different intent and cannot be refreshed or reused after expiry. An unauthorized caller, an account this service does not host, an unknown or not-currently-authorized device and a device outside the named account all return the same authority_mismatch. A malformed internal row that claims to be current/verified while omitting its authorization Event or generation is an integrity failure, not an authorization-absence decision. A block can name pending/revoked without disclosing any other private device state.

target_device_authorize_event_id.description: Origin-derived current device authorization Event. Present only for allow.

target_device_generation_ref.description: Origin-derived current device generation. Present only for allow.

accepted_device_possession_proof_digest.description: Present for human SessionGrant issue/refresh allow or block after proof validation; SHA-256 of the exact canonical AcceptedDevicePossessionProof. It cryptographically binds the gate decision to the proof verified under the locked current accepted-device key.

linearization_seq.description: Monotonic sequence from the origin Principal Server's durable device-revocation log.

expires_at.description: Hard receipt-use deadline no later than 30 seconds after linearized_at. It is a freshness bound, not a cache TTL and not a revocation deadline.

blocking_proposal_digest.description: For revocation_pending, the lexicographically smallest proposal_digest among all surviving pending records for the exact device/generation at linearization_seq. This deterministic witness does not imply that no other pending record exists.

covering_seal_id.description: For revoked, the covering Seal of the revoked record with the smallest (acceptance_seq, proposal_digest) among all revoked records for the exact device/generation at linearization_seq.

proof.description: Origin Principal Server signature with context ak.device_revocation_gate_decision_proof.v1. payload_digest MUST equal sha256(JCS(the complete receipt with proof omitted)); proof.verification_method MUST equal receipt.verification_method; proof.created_at MUST equal linearized_at; and the verification-method controller projected to Core MUST equal account_id.principal_server_id.
